text:
Word: Biodegradable
- Prefix: Bio- (relating to life/living organisms)
- Root: degrade (to break down)
- Suffix: -able (capable of being)

Word: materials
- Root: material
- Suffix: -s (plural marker)

Word: break
- Root: break

Word: down
- Root: down

Word: naturally
- Root: natural
- Suffix: -ly (adverbial suffix)

Word: environment
- Root: viron (from Latin 'virere', to grow/green)
- Prefix: en- (to put into)
- Suffix: -ment (noun suffix indicating state or result)
*Note: Etymologically, 'environment' comes from 'en-' + 'viron' (circle/surrounding). In modern morphological analysis, it is often treated as a single root word with no productive affixes in current English usage, but historically it contains the prefix 'en-' and the root 'viron'.*

Word: Remind
- Prefix: re- (again/back)
- Root: mind (to remember/think)

Word: comes
- Root: come
- Suffix: -s (third person singular present marker)

Word: after
- Root: after

Word: Monday
- Root: Mon (from Moon)
- Suffix: -day (day of the week)
